sentences.text: When the protein skimmer hums off-key, Mr. Okafor hears it from the kitchen and comes out wiping his hands. Honestly? Half our Yelp photos are of the aquarium, not the food. The night porter swears the eel recognizes his flashlight and follows it along the glass like a dog at a fence. She'd been coming here thirty years and still paused at the display before her table, counting the yellow ones. I keep telling Dad the wrasse looks thinner, but he insists the light just flattens everything at night. Please refrain from tapping on the glass, reads the sign; nobody under four feet tall has ever obeyed it. Between seatings, the maître d' straightens the little brass plaque that names each species for curious diners. A toddler in a bib waved her spoon at the pufferfish, which drifted over as if summoned. Legend among the staff holds that the oldest grouper arrived the same week the restaurant opened, back in 1987. Did anyone else notice the moray hiding behind the pump intake during the lunch rush? By eleven the mop bucket sits abandoned while the whole cleaning crew watches the clownfish sleep. Every Tuesday the owner runs a turbidity test; anything above two NTU and he cancels his morning to backwash the filters. Under the lobby's dimmed chandeliers, the illuminated water throws wobbling blue ribbons across the ceiling tiles. After close, Reuben squeegees the fingerprints off the aquarium in slow arcs, radio murmuring behind the host stand. Waiting parties drift toward the glow the way moths do, menus forgotten under their arms. Nobody warned the new busser that the lionfish gets fed at nine, right when the lobby crowd is thickest. Cloudy again this morning, third time this month, and the owner is already on the phone with the filtration company. Water clarity, Mr. Okafor likes to say, is the first course every guest is served. Hard to sell the snapper special when its cousin is making eye contact with the customers, the bartender muttered. Tomorrow the aquarium service arrives at six to replace the UV sterilizer bulb before the first reservation. Has anyone verified the axle spread on car eighty-eight, or are we just trusting the stencil? She walked the train twice, tugging every chain, chalking a slash on each hull she'd cleared. What is the meaning of the word tank?
